decision.candidate: equi-nogs: jointly refit with acceleration sensitivity A fixed zero
decision.status: Offline calibration completed; candidate parameters only. Not deployed.
decision.supported: Fixed offline IMU parameters substantially reduce OpenVINS runaway drift in both independent recordings without online IMU calibration.
decision.remaining: SchurVINS still diverges. The second recording still has metre-scale closure drift in OpenVINS; no GT/ATE evidence.
decision.direct_vs_preprocessing: Direct fixed Tw/Ta/R in OpenVINS is the preferred validation. External preprocessing keeps scalar noise and bias priors unchanged and gives different trajectories; both protocols are retained.
decision.solver_logging: Standard radtan/equi runs include iteration histories. The A=0 run exits successfully with all four outputs, but its captured stdout stops during preparation, so its iteration count is unknown.
